headline: New curriculum for Latin Historical Poetry and Women's History, plus curriculum revisions in technology education, geometry and statistics.
summary: Two new curriculums and two curriculum revisions are up for decisions. The agenda also covers 2027 committee dates, a discussion of Avenues of Opportunity for the District, and a report on fine arts.

Decision on new Latin Historical Poetry curriculum
Decision on new Women's History curriculum
Decision on Middle School Grade 6-8 Technology Education curriculum revision
Decision on High School Grade 9-12 Geometry and Statistics ACA/ACC curriculum revision
Information on Middle School and High School Grade 6-12 Fine Arts
